001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents a scheduled activity with a title, start time, end time, and
007 * optional comment.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Serves as the base class for {@link HomeActivity}, {@link SchoolActivity},
011 * and {@link OtherActivity}.
012 * </p>
013 * <p>
014 * The class stores its {@link Time} references directly and enforces
015 * that the title is non-null and non-blank, start and end times are non-null,
016 * and the start time is strictly before the end time. Any violation of these
017 * invariant conditions causes an {@link IllegalArgumentException} to be thrown.
018 * For example:
019 * </p>
020 * <pre>
021 * Time start = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 14, 30);
022 * Time end = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 16, 30);
023 * Activity lab = new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lab", start, end, "Bring laptop");
024 * </pre>
025 */
026public abstract class Activity implements Comparable<Activity> {
027    /**
028     * The title of this activity. Must be non-null and non-blank.
029     */
030    private String title;
031
032    /**
033     * The starting time of this activity. Must be non-null and strictly before endTime.
034     */
035    private Time startTime;
036
037    /**
038     * The ending time of this activity. Must be non-null and strictly after startTime.
039     */
040    private Time endTime;
041
042    /**
043     * Optional user comment or note associated with this activity.
044     */
045    private String comment;
046
047
048
049    /*
050     * Constructors
051     */
052
053    /**
054     * Protected default constructor for serialization and subclass initialization.
055     */
056    protected Activity() {}
057   
058    /**
059     * <p>
060     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, and end time.
061     * </p>
062     * 
063     * @param title     The activity title.
064     * @param startTime The start time.
065     * @param endTime   The end time.
066     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
067     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
068     *                                  strictly before endTime.
069     */
070    protected Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime)
071    throws IllegalArgumentException {
072        // Input validation is managed by the setters.
073        setTitle(title);
074        setStartTime(startTime);
075        setEndTime(endTime);
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * <p>
080     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> with a title, start time, end time, and
081     * comment.
082     * </p>
083     * 
084     * @param title     The activity title.
085     * @param startTime The start time.
086     * @param endTime   The end time.
087     * @param comment   The activity comment.
088     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
089     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
090     *                                  strictly before endTime.
091     */
092    protected Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)
093    throws IllegalArgumentException {
094        // Input validation is managed by the setters.
095        this(title, startTime, endTime);
096        setComment(comment);
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * <p>
101     * Constructs an <code>Activity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity Serial)
102     * string. Tokens are parsed in the following order:
103     * </p>
104     * <ol>
105     * <li>class name (ignored),</li>
106     * <li>title,</li>
107     * <li>start time,</li>
108     * <li>end time,</li>
109     * <li>comment (<code>NIL</code> is treated as no comment).</li>
110     * </ol>
111     * 
112     * @param ras RAS entry, such as
113     *            {@code <HomeActivity,Laundry,2026/10/20 09:00,2026/10/20 10:00,NIL>}.
114     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
115     */
116    protected Activity(String ras)
117    throws RasException {
118        RasParser.populate(this, ras);
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * <p>
123     * Copy constructor. Constructs a new <code>Activity</code> that is a
124     * duplicate of the given <code>Activity</code>, preventing co-references
125     * that could cause privacy leaks.
126     * </p>
127     *
128     * @param other The <code>Activity</code> to copy.
129     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
130     */
131    protected Activity(Activity other)
132    throws IllegalArgumentException {
133        if (other == null)
134            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot copy a null Activity.");
135        setTitle(other.getTitle());
136        setStartTime(other.getStartTime()); // getStartTime() already returns a copy
137        setEndTime(other.getEndTime());     // getEndTime() already returns a copy
138        setComment(other.getComment());     // String is immutable; no copy needed
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * Creates and returns a defensive copy of this activity.
143     * Subclasses implement this method using their copy constructors to prevent privacy leaks.
144     * 
145     * @return A duplicate copy of this Activity.
146     */
147    public abstract Activity copy();
148
149
150
151    /*
152     * Accessors
153     */
154   
155    /**
156     * Gets the title of this activity.
157     * 
158     * @return The activity title.
159     */
160    public String getTitle() {
161        return this.title;
162    }
163    
164    /**
165     * Gets the start time of this activity.
166     *
167     * <p>Returns a defensive copy so that external mutations of the returned
168     * {@link Time} cannot affect this activity's internal state.</p>
169     * 
170     * @return A copy of the activity start time.
171     */
172    public Time getStartTime() {
173        return new Time(this.startTime);
174    }
175  
176    /**
177     * Gets the end time of this activity.
178     *
179     * <p>Returns a defensive copy so that external mutations of the returned
180     * {@link Time} cannot affect this activity's internal state.</p>
181     * 
182     * @return A copy of the activity end time.
183     */
184    public Time getEndTime() {
185        return new Time(this.endTime);
186    }
187    
188    /**
189     * Gets the comment for this activity.
190     * 
191     * @return The activity comment, or <code>null</code> if none is defined.
192     */
193    public String getComment() {
194        return this.comment;
195    }
196
197
198
199    /**
200     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
201     * Activity.
202     * 
203     * @return Corresponding ActivityType.
204     */
205    public abstract ActivityType getType();
206
207
208
209    /*
210     * Mutators
211     */
212    
213    /**
214     * Sets the title of this activity.
215     * 
216     * @param title The new title.
217     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank.
218     */
219    public void setTitle(String title)
220    throws IllegalArgumentException {
221        if (title == null || title.isBlank())
222            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Title cannot be null or blank.");
223        
224        this.title = title;
225    }
226
227    /**
228     * Sets the start time of this activity.
229     *
230     * <p>Stores a defensive copy of {@code startTime} to prevent external
231     * mutations from affecting this activity's internal state.</p>
232     * 
233     * @param startTime The new start time.
234     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If startTime is null, or if an endTime is
235     *                                  already set and startTime is not strictly
236     *                                  before endTime.
237     */
238    public void setStartTime(Time startTime)
239    throws IllegalArgumentException {
240        if (startTime == null)
241            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start time cannot be null.");
242        if (this.endTime != null
243            && startTime.compareTo(this.endTime) >= 0)
244            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start time (" + startTime + ") must be before end time (" + this.endTime + ").");
245        
246        this.startTime = new Time(startTime);
247    }
248
249    /**
250     * Sets the end time of this activity.
251     *
252     * <p>Stores a defensive copy of {@code endTime} to prevent external
253     * mutations from affecting this activity's internal state.</p>
254     * 
255     * @param endTime The new end time.
256     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If endTime is null, or if a startTime is
257     *                                  already set and endTime is not strictly after startTime.
258     */
259    public void setEndTime(Time endTime)
260    throws IllegalArgumentException {
261        if (endTime == null)
262            throw new IllegalArgumentException("End time cannot be null.");
263        if (this.startTime != null
264            && this.startTime.compareTo(endTime) >= 0)
265            throw new IllegalArgumentException("End time (" + endTime + ") must be after start time (" + this.startTime + ").");
266        
267        this.endTime = new Time(endTime);
268    }
269
270    /**
271     * Sets the comment for this activity.
272     * 
273     * @param comment The new comment; null or blank values clear the comment.
274     */
275    public void setComment(String comment) {
276        if (comment == null || comment.isBlank())
277            this.comment = null;
278        else
279            this.comment = comment;
280    }
281
282
283
284    /*
285     * Serialization
286     */
287
288    /**
289     * <p>
290     * Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
291     * </p>
292     * <p>
293     * The RAS format is a comma-separated list wrapped in angle brackets, for
294     * example:
295     * </p>
296     * 
297     * <pre>
298     * &lt;ClassName,title,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,comment&gt;
299     * </pre>
300     * <p>
301     * If no comment is set, <code>NIL</code> is used as a placeholder. For example,
302     * a <code>HomeActivity</code> titled "Morning Run" with no comment might
303     * produce:
304     * </p>
305     * 
306     * <pre>
307     * &lt;HomeActivity,Morning Run,2026/01/01 07:00,2026/01/01 08:00,NIL&gt;
308     * </pre>
309     * 
310     * @return A single-line RAS representation; commas in field values are not
311     *         escaped.
312     */
313    public String toRAS() {
314        return RasParser.serialize(this);
315    }
316
317
318
319    /*
320     * Object Overrides
321     */
322
323    /**
324     * Returns a string representation of this activity.
325     * 
326     * @return A string representation of this activity.
327     */
328    @Override
329    public String toString() {
330        String str = String.format("%s (%s - %s)",
331            getTitle(),
332            getStartTime().toString(),
333            getEndTime().toString());
334
335        String comment = getComment();
336        if (comment != null && !comment.isBlank())
337            str = str + " (" + comment + ")";
338
339        return str;
340    }
341
342    /**
343     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another object.
344     * 
345     * @param other The object to compare with.
346     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
347     *         otherwise.
348     */
349    @Override
350    public boolean equals(Object other) {
351        if (this == other)
352            return true;
353        /*
354         * compare the class first. this is necessary because HomeActivity etc. are
355         * subclasses of this one and when comparing activities of different classes
356         * (i.e. HomeActivity and SchoolActivity), the two should always be treated as
357         * unequal.
358         */
359        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
360            return false;
361
362        Activity that = (Activity) other;
363
364        // compare title
365        if (getTitle() == null
366            ? that.getTitle() != null
367            : !getTitle().equals(that.getTitle()))
368            return false;
369
370        // compare start time
371        if (getStartTime() == null
372            ? that.getStartTime() != null
373            : !getStartTime().equals(that.getStartTime()))
374            return false;
375
376        // compare end time
377        if (getEndTime() == null
378            ? that.getEndTime() != null
379            : !getEndTime().equals(that.getEndTime()))
380            return false;
381
382        // compare comment
383        String c1 = getComment();
384        String c2 = that.getComment();
385        if (c1 == null || c1.isBlank())
386            return c2 == null || c2.isBlank();
387        return c1.equals(c2);
388    }
389
390    /**
391     * Compares this activity with another activity based on starting time.
392     * 
393     * @param other The other activity to compare with.
394     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this activity's
395     *         start time precedes, equals, or follows the other activity's start
396     *         time. Equal start times compare as zero even if other fields differ.
397     * @throws NullPointerException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
398     */
399    @Override
400    public int compareTo(Activity other)
401    throws NullPointerException {
402        if (other == null)
403            throw new NullPointerException("Cannot compare Activity to null");
404
405        /*
406         * since we are comparing based on a Time,
407         * which has its own compareTo method,
408         * we can just use that method :)
409         */
410        return getStartTime().compareTo(
411            other.getStartTime());
412    }
413}
